title: [review] coap_dtn register: k_mutex_init on held mutex + non-idempotent registration wipes state
description: P2. lichen_coap_deaddrop_register (coap_dtn.c:71-88) takes s_dtn_buf_mutex then lichen_coap_dtn_init() executes k_mutex_init(&s_dtn_buf_mutex) on the HELD mutex — ownership reset voids exclusion until the final ignored unlock; also re-k_work_init_delayable on a possibly-scheduled work item and re-lichen_dtn_init() wipes the buffer on double registration. Benign at today's boot-time-only use, hazard if ever called with traffic in flight. Fix: K_MUTEX_DEFINE static init (drop k_mutex_init pair), make register reject/reject-noop double init, verify work item handling.
